facts.fact: KT Press reports that Rwanda's National Artificial Intelligence Policy was approved by Cabinet in April 2023 and was launched by ICT Minister Paula Ingabire; no end date is given.

KT Press reports that on 8 June 2026 Cabinet approved the establishment of a National Artificial Intelligence Agency, described as following the 2023 AI policy and a dedicated platform for advancing its ambitions; structure and timeline were not yet public, and no funding is stated.
